title: Listing categories
description: Organize the marketplace catalog into a parent/child category tree used by listings and task requests.

help.title: About listing categories
help.overview: The categories of services: one tree for the whole platform. Every company files its listings under them, and clients post jobs in them. Only the company that runs the platform can change them; others see them read-only.

sections.title: Each category
items: Leave the parent empty for a top level. Order sorts categories on the same level, lowest first.
Where the work happens: on site, matched by distance to a listing's service area, or online, matched anywhere. A subcategory starts with its parent's choice.
When a client posts a job, providers with an active listing in its category, or a parent or subcategory of it, can hear about it.
Move listings to another category before deleting one that is still in use.

managedByOperator: Categories are shared by every company on the platform and kept by the marketplace operator.
